name: Royal Blood 2: Secret Lesson
source:
You're about to start your long awaited college life! From your first day on campus, you become acquainted with the mysterious Russel brothers and... Royal Blood is back with seductive vampires and hot bod werewolves! This is Royal Blood Season 2!

[From in-app]
translation:
期待已久的大学生活即将开始！踏进校园的第一天，你就结识了神秘的拉塞尔兄弟，然后……《Royal Blood》带着充满诱惑的吸血鬼和身材火辣的狼人回归了！欢迎来到《Royal Blood》第二季！

[摘自应用内]
